newsitem.title: FRANCE: French LCI TV hopes for breakeven by 2000.
newsitem.headline: French LCI TV hopes for breakeven by 2000.

text.p: French news television channel LCI, owned by broadcaster TF1, expects to reach breakeven by around 2000, chairman Etinees Mougeotte told a news conference on Monday.
"We hope to reach breakeven in the region of the year 2000, we're going fully according to plan," he said.
The French channel dedicated to news had around 1.09 million subscribers and was keen to produce an exportable news product, he said.
